changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Machine Translation' as the paper frames brain-to-text as analogous to translation but doesn't actually evaluate machine translation. Added 'EEG2text' task since the paper extensively evaluates this. Consolidated outputs for clarity.

Normalized all BLEU variants to 'BLEU' and ROUGE-1 to 'ROUGE' following simplification guidelines. Removed 'BLEU-N' (unclear variant), 'F', 'P', 'R' which appear to be precision/recall metrics but are not clearly defined for NLG evaluation.
No LLM evaluation was used in this paper. The paper uses traditional automatic metrics and case analysis only.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The evaluation relies solely on automatic metrics and qualitative case analysis.

overall_notes: The paper presents a novel brain-to-text generation task using cognitive signals (fMRI/EEG). Evaluation is based entirely on automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) with qualitative case analysis. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods were used. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric variants and clarification of task scope.
